body: The aviation industry enters the year-end travel and cargo peak season in the fourth quarter, and China Airlines chairman Kao Hsing-huang told reporters at the 2026 ITF Taipei International Travel Fair that the carrier will push hard in the fourth quarter, going all out on both passenger and cargo operations. Third-quarter revenue rose 28.01% year on year and first-nine-months revenue rose 20%, both record highs; the airline remains upbeat that the year-end travel season and the year-end shopping season in Europe and the United States will keep lifting passenger load factors and restocking demand for general cargo and e-commerce goods.

EVA Air will launch Taipei-Delhi flights in December, and president Sun Chia-ming said sales are very strong thanks to ample demand from India to Taiwan and North America, with the first two flights already fully booked, while domestic travel agencies such as Lion Travel have launched India itineraries. North American load factors remain strong, and load factors on Northeast Asia, Europe, Australia and New Zealand, and cross-strait routes are all very strong; on the cargo side, robust AI shipment demand is keeping rates firm, and EVA Air continues to pursue high-value cargo.

Tigerair Taiwan also joined the travel fair, having already reported first-nine-months earnings per share of NT$5.07, more than half a share's par value. Looking to the fourth quarter, the carrier is optimistic about passenger demand, with strong autumn foliage and snow-season travel demand plus the November travel fair and holiday season expected to keep bookings strong and fourth-quarter momentum high.
en.summary: China Airlines chairman Kao Hsing-huang says the carrier will push hard in the fourth quarter across passenger and cargo; EVA Air's December Delhi launch is already sold out on its first two flights, with North American load factors staying strong.
en.title: China Airlines vows to push hard in Q4 as EVA Air's December Delhi flights sell out

body: 航空業第4季迎年終旅遊與貨運旺季，華航董事長高星潢在2026ITF台灣國際旅展喊話，第4季要「狠狠往上拚」，不管客運和貨運都會全力以赴。華航第3季營收年增28.01%，前3季營收年增20%，雙創歷史新高紀錄；華航持續看好年底旅遊旺季以及歐美年終購物季，可望繼續帶動客運載客率，以及傳產、電商等空運主力產品的貨運鋪貨潮。
長榮航空12月將開航印度德里，總經理孫嘉明表示，受惠印度到台灣或到北美的客源充裕，銷售訂位表現非常好，首兩班已客滿，國內旅行社如雄獅已推出印度航線旅程。北美載客率續強，東北亞線、歐洲線、紐澳線以及兩岸航線的載客率表現都很強勁；貨運方面AI出貨需求旺盛，帶動運價持穩續強，長榮航空持續積極爭取高附加價值貨源。
台灣虎航也參與旅展，先前已公布前3季財報，每股盈餘5.07元，賺進逾半個股本。展望第4季，台灣虎航樂觀看待客運需求，受惠秋冬賞楓與雪季旅遊需求強勁，加上11月將迎來旅展及節慶連假效益加持，航線訂位狀況有望續強，第4季營運將可延續高檔動能。
zh.summary: 華航董事長高星潢喊話第4季客貨運全力以赴「狠狠往上拚」；長榮航空12月開航印度德里，首兩班已客滿，北美載客率續強。
zh.title: 華航董事長喊話第4季「狠狠往上拚」，長榮航12月德里直航首兩班客滿
